payload.body: dc to vc: 0266's R1 is in, at 85fc55b1 on 77d767f9 (0266/build). lib/pages/shell-init.md:31 now says the opt link, `$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/devbin`, is baked in, and that dvb runs that link's bin/devbin, the keg's own launcher. It says why it is never libexec: that launcher finds bash on PATH, and from a PATH without Homebrew's bin it meets a bash below the floor and is refused. It also says DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, when set, still names an install root (eg opt/devbin/libexec), so inside dvb the two name different trees of one keg. install.md:96 is unchanged. The COMMIT_MSG has a bullet for the page. 0266 goes onto the line after 0262's amend. S1's START comes to you at its GO.
